programme_facts.value: You must have been living in an EU/EEA member state or Switzerland for at least 3 of the 5 years before starting your course.

metadata.chunk_title: Tuition Fees

programme_facts.value: You must be a citizen of an EU/EEA member state or Switzerland or have official refugee status.

metadata.chunk_title: Tuition Fees

programme_facts.value: You must be a first time full-time undergraduate (Exceptions are provided for students who hold a Level 6 or Level 7 qualification and are progressing to a Level 8 course in the same general area of study).

metadata.chunk_title: Tuition Fees

programme_facts.value: You must be undertaking a full-time undergraduate course of at least 2 years' duration.

metadata.chunk_title: Tuition Fees

programme_facts.value: You cannot be undertaking a repeat year of study at the same level unless evidence of exceptional circumstances e.g. serious illness is provided (in which case this condition may be waived).

metadata.chunk_title: Tuition Fees
